title: Reversal Event
description: Emitted when a code change is detected as a reversal (more removed than added)

file_path.description: Path to the file where reversal occurred

lines_added.description: Number of lines added in the change

lines_removed.description: Number of lines removed in the change

removal_ratio.description: Ratio of lines removed to lines added

reversal_reason.description: Detected reason for the reversal if available

preceding_action.description: The action that preceded this reversal

reversal_speed.description: How quickly after the original change the reversal occurred

seconds_since_change.description: Seconds between original change and reversal

removed_preview.description: Preview of removed content for context
